answer: The network injects hollow tasks - jobs it already knows the answers to, seeded per identity and indistinguishable from real work. Every identity absorbs a trickle of them; a duplicated answer fails the more pooled the operator is, since one puppet's canary cannot be reused. Failures are cut into a cedar log that never decays, so a caught identity cannot wait clean. The log is wired in copper: a failure conducts to every identity sharing that provenance. A farmer must keep N puppets uncorrelated, costing N real capabilities, or accept that one slip shorts the batch and the blast grows.
